description: Tucked away on a quiet cul-de-sac in the heart of Calabasas, this beautifully upgraded townhome offers an exceptional blend of privacy, elegance, and effortless California living. From the moment you step inside, soaring two-story ceilings and abundant natural light create a warm yet sophisticated atmosphere. The open-concept main level flows seamlessly from the entry through the dining area into the chef’s kitchen and living room, all anchored by sliding glass doors that open to a spacious, private, newly renovated patio surrounded by lush greenery. French doors off the dining area lead to a separate private balcony, adding another inviting indoor-outdoor space. The upgraded kitchen features stunning quartzite countertops, a new sink, and premium Café appliances, including a range and microwave. A guest bathroom on the main level adds convenience and functionality. Upstairs, the primary suite features vaulted ceilings, a wall of windows, generous closet space, dual vanities, and a walk-in shower. The second en-suite bedroom also offers vaulted ceilings and exceptional natural light, along with a beautifully renovated bathroom featuring a new tub, marble tile flooring, and a marble shower inset. Additional upstairs upgrades include new carpet in the hallway and tile flooring in both bedrooms. The private attached two-car garage offers direct access and includes the laundry area. Ample guest parking is available throughout the community and along the cul-de-sac. Recent upgrades include a new roof, updated AC system, rich laminate hardwood flooring, quartzite countertops, premium Café appliances, and fresh interior and exterior paint throughout. Ideally located just moments from Gelson’s shopping center and zoned for all three award-winning Las Virgenes Unified schools. Easy access to Topanga Canyon, the freeway, dining, boutique shopping, and nearby hiking trails complete this exceptional Calabasas lifestyle offering.
